issues.description: Method Farm.singFarmSongVerse: the template declares singFarmSongVerse without an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), while the problem statement UML and the solution implementation define singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch prevents students from implementing singFarmSong() by iterating over animals and calling singFarmSongVerse(animal), and would cause compilation/usage issues if students follow the specification or solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template signature to accept an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update the method body to use that parameter. This aligns the template with the UML/specification and the solution so students can implement singFarmSong() by iterating animals and invoking singFarmSongVerse(animal).

issues.description: Example usage in the template Main.java calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and the reference solution define and describe the API as feedAllAnimals(). The inconsistent method name in the commented example may confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() to match the problem statement and solution, or alternatively add a short wrapper method feed() in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() so the example and required API are both supported.
